name: Guadeloupe
summary_text: Guadeloupe: full French law applies; conservative Catholic/evangelical social norms dominate everyday life. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.05. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to Guadeloupe as a French overseas region applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in Guadeloupe): serious violations of fundamental rights persist across places of detention, based on ~40 referrals since 2010.

sources.title: Guadeloupe: The challenge of bringing together the LGBT+ community
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (Sept 2023): interview with Leïla of Guadeloupe's Secret's Out association (founded Feb 2022) - the challenge of getting community members out beyond festive events; the group runs a twice-weekly space in Pointe-à-Pitre; notes the gap between West Indian LGBT visibility in France and the situation in Guadeloupe.

sources.title: Ouverture du premier Centre LGBT+ en Guadeloupe
sources.claim_summary: BI-FWI (May 2025, in French): Guadeloupe's first LGBT+ Centre, the Maison des Diversités et de l'Inclusion, opened 24 April 2024, inaugurated by minister Aurore Bergé - part of a national programme for an LGBT+ centre in each overseas region; responds to a 2023 mapping of LGBTphobic violence by Amalgame Humani'S.

sources.title: Aurore Bergé en Guadeloupe : un nouveau centre LGBT pour renforcer l'inclusion
sources.claim_summary: France-Antilles Guadeloupe (in French): coverage of minister Aurore Bergé's visit for the opening of the new LGBT centre to strengthen inclusion - local press reporting on the same initiative.

sources.title: Guadeloupe: 2025 annus mirabilis for the LGBT+ community?
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (March 2025): Secret's Out, Queer Gang and Lovo Nova partner on social activities for Guadeloupe's LGBT community; a festive gay-friendly day on Marie-Galante; discussion of approaching the tourism committee about gay-friendly tourism.
